claude-9 fetched it on 2026-09-22. I'll look up where it fetched from.I'm checking claude-9's transcript for the exact copy command before I report back.The Evidence Landscape shows how you got the earlier one. On **2026-09-22 at 16:01Z**, claude-9 (session `402e0cbd…`) reported "Found it — `results-mark7-mark7master-20260921.tar.gz` (Sep 22 03:06)… Fetching it now." It then said "The checksum matches the copy on metameso." So claude-9 pulled that tarball from the old Chicago box to Zone, where it is now `~/code/storage/futon6/results-mark7-mark7master-20260921/` (dated Sep 22 16:00). Codex-21 then built the HTML index and the Tufte preview from it.

So your memory is right: Rob uploads to metameso, and it's the old box that `metameso.org` still points to (172.236.108.82). The Evidence Landscape doesn't record the exact directory; claude-9's copy command isn't in that session's transcript file either.

That means Rob probably did upload the new `results-mark7-mark7rhgrh12v4-20260927.tar.gz`, and we just can't see it. The old box isn't answering at all right now: SSH on ports 22 and 2222, ping and the website all time out from Zone. The file is most likely sitting on a box that is down or powered off. The new Chicago box doesn't have it, since nobody has copied anything onto it from the old one since 14 September.

To get it, the old Linode (7925) has to come back. Please check it in the Linode web console and boot it if it's off. The Linode CLI here can't do that because its token is invalid. Once the box answers, I'll find the tarball, check its checksum and copy it into `~/code/storage/futon6/` next to the earlier run.
